name: Ahmed Ismail
tagline: Queue-driven systems, scalable APIs, and real-time backends for high-traffic products.
intro: Expert in building scalable APIs, queue-driven workflows, and high-concurrency backends with PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Redis, and PostgreSQL.
about: Backend Developer with 5+ years bridging reliable server architecture and product delivery. I ship complete, scalable backend systems tailored to travel, SaaS, marketplace, and mobile products.

aboutPillars.title: The Vision
aboutPillars.body: I don't just write endpoints — I build systems that stay up under traffic. Clear domains, documented spikes, and APIs clients can trust.

aboutPillars.title: API Craft
aboutPillars.body: REST APIs tuned for React and Flutter, OpenAPI docs, modular supplier integrations, and multi-tenant product backends.

aboutPillars.title: Backend Architecture
aboutPillars.body: Queues, WebSockets, Redis caching, streaming pipelines, Docker, and CI/CD — the layer that makes high-traffic products feel instant.

services.title: Backend & API
services.body: Robust server-side logic, database design, and secure API integration.

services.title: Queues & Realtime
services.body: Job workers, WebSockets, and data pipelines for products that update live.

services.title: Product backends
services.body: Multi-tenant SaaS and commerce backends from architecture to production.

services.title: Integrations
services.body: Payment gateways and travel-supplier APIs — checkout, hotel mapping, search, rates, and booking flows.

experience.title: Backend Software Engineer

Live availability and pricing via Laravel Reverb WebSockets, with short-polling fallback.
CSV streaming pipelines for large hotel/geography datasets; Horizon queues for third-party content sync.
Redis caching / materialized search, Meilisearch, and PostgreSQL GiST geo indexes; Docker + CI/CD deploys.
